head: dd5572c0d53d35a31073d1130fb6223ce7c7f648
claim: An app on the released @byokit packages can no longer launch Pi without an explicit model or pass on an ambient provider key, can sign a second ChatGPT account in place with a duplicate login refused and a wrong-login re-auth marked needs again, and reads an account whose sign-in check gives no answer as unknown with a retry time, never signed out, while its sibling stays ready.

target.version: released @byokit packages: accounts 0.33.0, openclaw 0.28.0, decide 0.16.2, herdr 0.16.7, phone 0.1.5 (built public entries)

steps.start: isolated folders, fake ambient provider key, loopback stand-ins only; no real account, provider or network
steps: Launch Pi with no model, an empty model or a provider-only model: it is refused with zero requests even with an ambient provider key set
Launch Pi with an explicit model: it answers Umer and the ambient provider key is not passed on
Sign a second ChatGPT account in place: it lands on its own store
Sign in again as the same person: the sign-in is refused as a duplicate and nothing is moved
Sign in again on an account as a different person: the account is marked needs again with identity mismatch
Check an account whose sign-in check gives no answer: it reads unknown with a retry time, never signed out, while its sibling stays ready
steps.result: Pi never runs without an explicit model or an ambient key, an in-place sign-in never moves or overwrites another account, and an unchecked sign-in reads unknown, never signed out.

verdicts.seen: Read the header and 3 summary lines. They state the Pi refusal with zero requests, duplicate refused with nothing moved, identity_mismatch marked needs_again, and unknown with retryAfterMs while the sibling stays ready. The header and summary line up with the detailed captures. Summary only, so the evidence sits in captures 1-3.

Read one JSON object and PASS. guardedMissingModelRequests is 0 for rawNativeMissingModel, and the explicit model yields answer Umer. It does not show an ambient key set (selectedEnvironmentHasAmbientKey is false), so the ambient-key part is only partly shown. The missing-model refusal with zero requests is shown.

Read 9 entries. Umer's new sign-in gives state failed, why duplicate, existing openai.670f09. The overlapping duplicate gives why duplicate. Re-auth as the wrong login gives why identity_mismatch with the 'different account' error on the original id. The text shows identity_mismatch but not the literal needs_again label. Account list shows both ready, and IN-PLACE OK.

Read 4 entries. Slow probe on A gives state unknown, reason timeout, retryAfterMs 5000, with b ready. The unreadable case gives unreadable then ready. Revoked A gives signed_out, a separate case. The run on an unchecked account gives network with retryAfterMs 5000. The unknown-with-retry and sibling-ready parts are shown; never-signed-out is shown by the timeout entry reading unknown, not signed_out.
